zh: 未來領取規劃支援每月或每年領取，與供款頻率分開設定。「10年後每月拿4000，拿20年，每年存錢」可直接識別；先說目前月薪再說未來領取目標時，不再混用兩個金額。新增繁中、簡中及英文原句回歸。
月領使用實際月度現金流：儲蓄10年後第121個月末開始，20年共240次；按有效年回報換算月回報、月末提款、不再投資已領款項，並按每個領取年度調升金額。年度匯總、收益曲線和IRR共用同一份月度記錄。
修正月供方案每日預算誤用另一條年供路線數字的問題。月供現在以所選月供乘12再除365；一次性投入另列扣除現有本金後仍需補足的金額。
月领分析書保留完整逐年資料，補充首個領取年度逐月明細；比較方案若出現不足款，展示首次缺口年度的月度明細。只會支付可用餘額，不把未付金額當成已領收入。
海報明確保留本金、準備期、假設年回報、領取額、領取頻率、期數和供款預算。修正英文分析書長標題/說明造成的表格底部溢出，保持完整12個月、自然行高和原字號。
月領方案不再提供會靜默轉為年領的保單演示入口；舊年度模型、利益表分析和既有語句保持相容。所有回報均為演示假設，不是產品報價或永久領取保證。
en: Added monthly and annual payout frequencies independently of contribution frequency. The original monthly-income/annual-funding phrase is covered in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English; current salary is kept separate from future requested income.

Monthly plans now use actual month-end cash flows: after ten saving years the first payout is at month 121, with 240 payouts over twenty years. Effective monthly returns, annual payout step-ups, non-reinvested withdrawals, annual summaries, charts and IRR share one journal.

Fixed daily budget equivalents using the wrong annual-funding alternative for monthly-funded plans. Daily budgets now follow the selected funding schedule, and additional lump sums deduct existing capital explicitly.

Reports retain complete annual summaries and add a twelve-month view of the first payout year. Underfunded comparisons show the first shortfall year's monthly detail instead of treating unfunded requests as cash received.

Posters preserve principal, saving horizon, assumed return, payout amount/frequency/count and funding budgets. Fixed English report table overflow without dropping monthly rows or reducing font sizes.

Monthly plans are not silently converted to the annual-only insurance simulator. Existing annual APIs, benefit-table analysis and prior regressions remain supported. All returns remain illustrative assumptions, not product quotations or guarantees.
